reviews.review:
Banzai Escape is like Time Crisis if it had been an anime instead of an arcade game. 
It's rough around the edges with a few clunky mechanics, but the core gameplay is a fun, short on-rails shooter. 

The graphics will put some people off - particularly the poor character movements and facial expressions, but I enjoyed the overall aesthetic of the game. It will appeal to anyone who enjoys that "cute military" style of anime (I don't know the actual genre name for it). It reminds me a bit of Valkyria Chronicles with a chibi spin.
